title: Neck side stretch
instruction: Ear toward shoulder, other shoulder stays down.
how_to: Sit or stand tall and relax both shoulders.
Tilt your head so your right ear moves toward your right shoulder.
Keep the left shoulder down. Hold for 20 seconds.
Return to centre and repeat on the other side.

title: Chin tuck
instruction: Pull your chin straight back to make a double chin.
how_to: Sit tall and look straight ahead.
Slide your chin straight back, as if making a double chin.
Hold for 10 seconds without tilting your head.
Release and repeat 3 times.

title: Doorway stretch
instruction: Forearms on the frame, lean gently forward.
how_to: Stand in a doorway with both forearms on the frame, elbows at shoulder height.
Step one foot forward.
Lean gently until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Hold for 30 seconds and breathe slowly.

title: Shoulder rolls
instruction: Roll shoulders back slowly, then forward.
how_to: Let your arms hang loose.
Lift your shoulders toward your ears.
Roll them slowly back and down, 5 times.
Reverse the direction for 5 more.

title: Thoracic extension
instruction: Hands behind your head, arch back over your chair.
how_to: Sit tall with your upper back against the top of the chair.
Lace your hands behind your head, elbows pointing forward.
Gently arch your upper back over the chair, then come back up.
Repeat 10 slow reps, breathing out as you arch.

instruction: Look at something about 6 metres away.
how_to: Look away from the screen.
Pick something about 6 metres (20 feet) away.
Keep your eyes on it for 20 seconds.
Blink slowly a few times.

title: Walkaround
instruction: Get up and walk. Refill your water, rest your eyes.
how_to: Stand up and leave your desk.
Walk around for about 2 minutes.
Refill your water or look out of a window.
Come back refreshed.
